from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j] == 2 for i in range(len(grid)))]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)], [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(rb, rb[1:]):
        line = []
        for c, d in zip(cb, cb[1:]):
            n = sum(grid[i][j] != background and grid[i][j] != 2 for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d))
            line.append(1 if n == 2 else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
